claim: For n=6,7,8, Kronecker-square multiplicity vectors determine S_n irreducibles up to conjugation, with 109 lex-first separators.

correctness.evidence: Independent Frobenius-formula character tables passed orthogonality; exact class-sum Kronecker squares yield 6/8/12 vectors with fibers precisely conjugation classes and 15/28/66 first separators.

originality.evidence: Tensor-square/Saxl searches found constituent-positivity literature but no complete-square collision/separation theorem for n=6,7,8 or the 109 separator certificates.

value.evidence: The exact small-rank uniqueness boundary and minimal separator list provide reusable character-recognition fingerprints and regression certificates.
